correctness.rationale: In RESULT.md steps 1-2, F bounded above by epsilon forces both successive Brownian differences to remain below 3epsilon and to have O(epsilon) endpoints; conversely, positive-area strictly interior terminal values with two suprema below epsilon/2 force F<epsilon. Whitening of the 2-dimensional Gaussian covariance gives a planar survival wedge of opening angle theta=acos(-rho), with start and end at O(epsilon). The displayed Dirichlet wedge Bessel kernel has leading density delta^(2*pi/theta) times a positive product of angular harmonics; integration over a positive-area scaled terminal rectangle contributes delta^2. Both inclusions yield exactly the claimed two-sided exponent. The Bessel series convergence and boundary cases rho strictly in (-1,1) are handled analytically, not by finite paths. Independently recalculated the cited 3-state covariance C=(1/9)[[14,-13],[-13,14]], rho=-13/14 and exponent 18.523774800939645.
residual_risks: The proof uses standard wedge Dirichlet heat-kernel expansion and uniform bounded-set control; no exact last-passage asymptotic prefactor is claimed.
